item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:30 PM 12 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(SanRoque, Pambujan, Laoang, Palapag, Mapanas, Gamay), #Marinduque(Mogpog, SantaCruz), #CamarinesSur(SanJose, Tigaon, Sagñay, Goa, Libmanan, Lupi, Ragay, DelGallego), #CamarinesNorte(Labo), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, Pandan), #Masbate(Cataingan, Cawayan and Palanas) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(LopeDeVega, Catarman, SilvinoLobos, Mondragon, Catubig, LasNavas, Lapinig), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Garchitorena, Lagonoy, Presentacion, Sipocot, Cabusao, Calabanga, Tinambac, Siruma), #Catanduanes(SanAndres), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud, Daet, SanLorenzoRuiz, Talisay, SanVicente, Vinzons, Paracale, JosePanganiban), #Masbate(Placer, Esperanza and PioV.Corpuz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
